subject: Security review kickoff & questionnaire - Zenith Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@zenithhealth.com>, David Liu <david.liu@zenithhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Security review kickoff & questionnaire - Zenith Health

Hi Aisha / David —

Great to meet today — thanks for the time and for walking us through Zenith's use case for patient-facing summarization. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

1) Scope we discussed
   - Production flow: ingestion from EHR extracts -> internal data lake (S3) -> Redwood inference APIs for on-the-fly summaries.
   - PHI: you confirmed summaries will include limited PHI (patient name/ID), so we should treat this as regulated data in scope.

2) Immediate asks from your side
   - Stakeholder mapping: economic buyer, security, legal, procurement contacts and usual procurement timeline.
   - Completed questionnaire: we've attached a draft security questionnaire (fillable PDF) to capture in-scope systems and controls.

3) Redwood next steps
   - Kickoff call with our security engineer + solutions engineer to walk the questionnaire and clarify system boundaries.
   - Provide SOC2, encryption, and retention evidence in parallel (we'll surface the standard artifacts).

Proposed timing: Can we schedule the technical security kickoff next week? I'm available Tue/Wed morning PST.

Attachments: redwood-security-questionnaire-zenith-draft.pdf, stakeholder-map-zenith.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to working through this with you.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

--

Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff & questionnaire - Zenith Health

Thanks Marissa — great meeting. A few notes from our side and initial stakeholder mapping below: 

- Economic buyer: Rajiv Menon, VP Product (rajiv.menon@zenithhealth.com) — final approval for commercial terms.
- Security technical owner: Aisha Patel (me) — I'll coordinate the technical review and SOC/pen-test evidence.
- Legal: David Liu (cc) — will own contract terms and any data processing addenda (DPA).
- Procurement: Procurement typically runs on a 3-4 week track for new vendors; our standard PO + contract cadence.

Systems likely in scope (pending our internal mapping):
- EHR extracts (Epic) — inbound feed into S3
- Internal data lake (AWS S3 + Glue)
- Analytics cluster (Databricks) for pre/post processing
- User-facing app (mobile/web) where summaries are surfaced

We can do the kickoff next Wednesday (Apr 21) at 10:00 AM ET (7:00 AM PT). If that works for you, please send a calendar invite and a brief agenda.

I'll start filling the questionnaire and attach what I have so far.

Thanks,
Aisha
Director, Security Engineering
Zenith Health

Attachment: zenith-security-questionnaire-completed.pdf (partial)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@zenithhealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@zenithhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, David Liu <david.liu@zenithhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff & questionnaire - Zenith Health

Hi Aisha / Rajiv / David —

Thanks for the quick mapping, and that proposed time works for our team. Calendar invite sent (Zoom link in the invite and on the drive link below).

A couple of clarifications ahead of the kickoff so we can prioritize questionnaire sections: 
- PHI scope: since patient identifiers are present in summaries, we'll treat EHR + data lake as in-scope for encryption at rest/in transit and access controls. Please confirm if there are any PHI elements processed downstream in analytics clusters that are not de-identified.
- Connectivity: Are there any on-prem EHR connectors or is the ingestion fully cloud-to-cloud? If there are on-prem gateways, we may need to capture VPN/whitelisting configurations.
- Retention: What is your desired retention window for raw extracts vs. generated summaries? (We typically see 90/180/365-day asks.)

What to expect on the kickoff: walk through questionnaire responses, identify gaps, and agree on evidence requests (SOC2, pen-test report, architecture diagram, KMS encryption details). Neha (security PM) will drive evidence collection; Rishi (solutions engineering) will join to map integration points.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/zenith/ZN-2027-034/security-questionnaire
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=kickoff

Best,
Marissa

--

Thanks — invite accepted. One quick answer: ingestion is cloud-to-cloud via secure S3 transfer; no on-prem gateways in the initial integration. Retention target for summaries: 180 days; raw extracts: 365 days.

I've uploaded the partially completed questionnaire to the drive link and attached a PDF export here. We'll have legal review the DPA language after the technical kickoff.

Attachment: zenith-security-questionnaire-completed.pdf

Aisha
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Zenith Health security kickoff prep / next steps

Quick internal note following Aisha's responses and the uploaded questionnaire: 

- Economic buyer: Rajiv Menon (VP Product) — expected to be the final approver; loop in for commercial terms after technical fit confirmed.
- Procurement timeline: ~3-4 weeks; legal to review DPA post-kickoff.
- Systems in scope: Epic exports (S3), AWS data lake, Databricks analytics, user-facing web/mobile. PHI present => full controls required.
- Retention targets provided: summaries=180d, raw extracts=365d.

Action items: 
1) Neha: prepare SOC2 + pen-test + architecture diagram + KMS encryption spec for kickoff.
2) Rishi: prepare integration checklist and a short demo of how we handle PHI masking/filters and prefix caching for reduced token costs.
3) I'll own coordination with Rajiv and procurement (deal_id ZN-2027-034).

Let's be prepared to capture any additional evidence requests on Wed's kickoff.

Thanks,
Marissa
